name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.NoiseHandle.linear_fresh_card_le_finrank
title: Linear evaluation: at most dim V paths admit a perturbation of the ciphertext that moves only their own value
statement: Let V be a finite-dimensional vector space over a field K (the ciphertext, or its LWE part mod a prime q), and phi_w : V -> U linear maps (the decryptor's computation of path w, e.g. BGG+ evaluation or a GGH15 product with public right factors). Let S be a set of paths such that for every w in S there is a direction x with phi_w(x) != 0 and phi_v(x) = 0 for all other v in S (a perturbation that moves path w and no other path of S). Then |S| <= dim V. So a linear-evaluation ciphertext admits per-path hops of this kind on at most dim V paths at once.
